card.name: Plural endings in proper names and titles
card.fires_on: Plural noun endings (such as -isters, -ats, -ians, -ickets, -lets) or plural nouns like revolutions or Adventures, often inside a capitalized name or title, where the next word is likely "of" or a continuation.

modes.label: Plural ending inside a name
modes.description: A broken-up proper name whose last piece is a plural ending, such as a place, group or band name.

modes.description: A plural noun that starts a title or phrase and is followed by "of".
